data.name: Captain's Crew
data.detailed_description:
FROM CASTAWAY TO LEGEND

Awaken on the shores of a deserted island with nothing but your will to survive. Captain's Crew is an open-world survival adventure where you must rise from a lost shipwrecked sailor to the most feared pirate of the seas.

Your goal is clear: gather resources, rebuild your strength, and hunt down the pirate captain who destroyed your fleet.

KEY FEATURES

  • SURVIVE THE WILD

    You start with nothing. Hunt for food, find fresh water, and craft basic tools to endure the harsh island elements.

  • BUILD YOUR PIRATE HAVEN

    Establish a settlement on your starting island. Construct buildings, manage resources, and create a thriving base of operations for your future empire.

  • ASSEMBLE YOUR FLEET

    Gather materials to construct vessels ranging from simple rafts to mighty galleons. Prepare your ships for the dangers of the open ocean.

  • RECRUIT YOUR CREW

    You can't sail a warship alone. Explore the world to find survivors and mercenaries. Hire them to work in your base or man the cannons on your ship.

  • EXPLORE & CONQUER

    Set sail across a stylized 3D archipelago. Discover hidden treasures, fight rival pirates, and uncover the secrets of the islands.

Will you reclaim your honor, Captain?

data.short_description: From castaway to sea legend. Survive on wild islands, build your base from scratch, and gather materials to construct an unstoppable fleet. Recruit a loyal crew, manage resources, and sail the ocean to settle the score with the captain who sank your ship.
